scope: opt-in beta passport profile only; production and the default beta profile remain unchanged

enabled.credential_rules: private beta-only source file, mounted only by gateway and signing-keys, no inline environment value, 32 to 256 safe ASCII characters, distinct from DSC operator and internal API credentials, absent from other rendered settings and mounted secrets

disabled: no CSCA issuance flag or credential file is selected by the beta passport profile when omitted
preflight: read and validate the dedicated beta-only source file only when EnablePassportNative is selected; fail before any image or service mutation without exposing its value
